objectives.description: Implement doc-version with pre-write GET and base_rev concurrency
Implement 4 distinct exit paths: 409 head_moved, 202 people_propose, 404 share_gone, 200/201 save

approaches_tried.approach: 'echo ... | jq ... 2>/dev/null >&2' to print jq's stdout to the real stderr while suppressing jq's own stderr
approaches_tried.reason: redirection order matters: 2>/dev/null first points fd2 at /dev/null, then >&2 dups fd1 from that already-redirected fd2, silently discarding both streams. Fixed by reversing to '>&2 2>/dev/null'.
